steps.eval: JSON.stringify((()=>{const T=window.__T,out=[];const houses=[],trees=[];window.__S.traverse(o=>{if(!o.isMesh||!o.visible)return;const n=o.name||'';if(/^bucket-(thatch|tile|brick|plaster|timber)/.test(n))houses.push(o);if(/^tree-.*-(mid|near)$/.test(n)&&!/hull/.test(n))trees.push(o);});const hb=houses.map(o=>({n:o.name,b:new T.Box3().setFromObject(o)}));const res=[];for(const t of trees){if(t.isInstancedMesh){const m4=new T.Matrix4(),bb=t.geometry.boundingBox||(t.geometry.computeBoundingBox(),t.geometry.boundingBox);for(let k=0;k<t.count;k++){t.getMatrixAt(k,m4);m4.premultiply(t.matrixWorld);const b=new T.Box3().copy(bb).applyMatrix4(m4);for(const h of hb)if(b.intersectsBox(h.b)){const ib=b.clone().intersect(h.b);const v=(ib.max.x-ib.min.x)*(ib.max.y-ib.min.y)*(ib.max.z-ib.min.z);if(v>0.5)res.push({tree:t.name,i:k,house:h.n,vol:+v.toFixed(2),at:[+((b.min.x+b.max.x)/2).toFixed(1),+((b.min.z+b.max.z)/2).toFixed(1)]});}}}}return res.sort((a,b)=>b.vol-a.vol).slice(0,12);})())

steps.note: H2 - repetition: how many DISTINCT transforms does the rim hedgerow really have?

steps.eval: JSON.stringify((()=>{const T=window.__T,o=[];window.__S.traverse(x=>{if(x.isInstancedMesh&&/^tree-(hedge|hedgeb|bush|bushb)-/.test(x.name||''))o.push(x);});const out=[];for(const m of o){const m4=new T.Matrix4(),p=new T.Vector3(),q=new T.Quaternion(),s=new T.Vector3();const sc=[],yaw=[];for(let i=0;i<m.count;i++){m.getMatrixAt(i,m4);m4.decompose(p,q,s);sc.push(+s.x.toFixed(3));yaw.push(+(2*Math.atan2(q.y,q.w)).toFixed(3));}const us=new Set(sc),uy=new Set(yaw);out.push({n:m.name,count:m.count,uniqScale:us.size,scaleMin:Math.min(...sc),scaleMax:Math.max(...sc),uniqYaw:uy.size});}return out;})())
